cim: Artificial intelligence in a Jesuit University: A student conversation
cim_eredeti: Artificial intelligence in a Jesuit University: A student conversation
szoveg_eredeti:
Raynor Library’s Connect team will facilitate a student-centered discussion on artificial intelligence on Wednesday, Nov. 4, starting at 6 p.m. in the Raynor Library Beaumier Suites.

This event is designed to gather student perspectives on a variety of issues concerning AI engagement and discerning AI.

This will be an open, welcoming environment for student discussions. Students’ MUID will be required for entry and no registration is required. There will be pizza, salad and soda provided.

The event is presented by Raynor Library and MU’s Discerning AI Research Community.
